title: Registratie uitstroom en bestemming schoolverlaters 1996 - RUBS'96 - BVE Monitor
authors: Research Centre for Education and the Labour Market – ROA, Maastricht University

descriptions: Survey concerning the destinations of graduated and non-graduated school-leavers entering further education and the labour market.
